To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The nutritional status of patients undergoing BMT is influenced by the conditioning regimen and the occurrence of organ dysfunction.

1) the use of TPN during the first month following BMT was associated with a significantly higher incidence of infection and organ failure; 2) the use of enteral nutrition was associated with a lower incidence of organ dysfunction; and 3) the use of oral nutrition was associated with the best outcomes in terms of survival and organ dysfunction.
the nutritional support of BMT patients can be accomplished safely and effectively by using TPN in the early period after transplantation and oral feedings later.
